intro: Global design meets everyday comfort. ACE’s European styling and ergonomic support redefine workday comfort, bringing effortless movement and modern elegance to your space.

features.title: Adjust it your way
features.text: No two people sit the same, and this chair gets that. You can customise everything with the back rest and neck rest as you move and shift. Move the seat forward or back to support your thighs. The armrests adjust in three ways.

features.title: Durable yet comfortable
features.text: Built to last, the ACE chair features a flexible Polymer Elastomer Mesh back, a sturdy nylon frame, and a polished aluminum spine—durable for daily use, comfortable for hours, and stylish for any workspace.

features.title: Moves with you, not against you
features.text: Ever leaned back and fought your chair? Not here. The Active Bio-Synchro mechanism adapts to your weight, gliding smoothly as you recline—keeping your back supported every step of the way.

features.title: Lumbar support that just knows
features.text: ACE’s Bioflex lumbar support flexes with you, giving you consistent comfort whether you’re sitting up straight or reclining. No adjusting, no hassle—it just works.

features.title: Good for you, good for the planet
features.text: Comfort shouldn’t come at the planet’s expense. That’s why this chair has GREENGUARD GOLD certification—meaning it’s safe for your lungs, your family, and the environment. Fewer harmful emissions, healthier spaces.

features.title: Lower back support that fits like a glove
features.text: Everyone’s back is different, which is why you can adjust the lumbar support height to get that just-right feeling in your lower back.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
